lines.text: My biggest units had a problem. When they died... the fight was just over.
Seven riveters with giant wrenches. One steam landship. They take it apart.
All that steel, gone in a second. It felt unfair.
So I gave it a crew. When the landship falls... they bail out and keep fighting.
Two carbineers. And they finish the job.
Should every big unit get a second life? Yes or no?
